'''Carreras Minor''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. In [[138 ABY]], an [[Water/Legends|ice]] [[Carreras Minor ice mining platform|mining platform]] was operational on the planet's [[Planetary ring/Legends|ring]].<ref name="Legacy 1" />
